landmarks.name: Port of Santa Margherita Ligure
landmarks.fact: A picturesque harbor on the Italian Riviera, famous for its colorful buildings, luxury yachts, and traditional fishing boats.

landmarks.name: Grand Hotel Miramare
landmarks.fact: A landmark luxury hotel in Santa Margherita Ligure where Guglielmo Marconi conducted pioneering radio communication experiments in 1933.

landmarks.name: Paraggi Bay
landmarks.fact: A stunning cove nestled between Santa Margherita Ligure and Portofino, famous for its emerald-green waters and sandy beach.

landmarks.name: Church of San Martino
landmarks.fact: A 12th-century Divo Martino church in Portofino featuring a distinctive striped facade and historic religious artwork inside.

landmarks.name: Piazzetta di Portofino
landmarks.fact: The iconic main square of Portofino overlooking the harbor, surrounded by pastel-colored houses, boutique shops, and cafes.

landmarks.name: Castello Brown
landmarks.fact: A historic fortress and house museum perched above Portofino, offering panoramic views of the harbor and Ligurian coastline.
